name: release-tag-protection
description: Release tag protection (v*): prevent deletion and retagging of release versions, and restrict who may cut one. F-02: the `creation` rule means ONLY bypass actors can create a matching ref, so with an empty bypass_actors list nobody could create a v* tag at all — and a v* tag is deploy.yml's only non-break-glass route to production, so the release path was closed. The bypass actor is OrganizationAdmin because the `release-managers` team named in the previous version of this description DOES NOT EXIST in the Hexaware-HnI organization (orgs/Hexaware-HnI/teams is empty; the slug 404s), so a Team actor could not be resolved and the intent was never expressed. When that team is created, add {"actor_type": "Team", "actor_id": <team id>, "bypass_mode": "always"} here and decide explicitly whether OrganizationAdmin should remain. The `creation` rule takes NO parameters: the previous version nested a required_status_checks block under it, which is not in the rule's schema — GitHub dropped it on apply, so the live ruleset never carried it and the file misrepresented what was enforced. Status checks on a tag ref belong in a separate required_status_checks rule if they are wanted at all; today prod release integrity is enforced in deploy.yml's `resolve` job instead (v* ref check plus git merge-base ancestry against origin/main). backend/tests/unit/tools/ci/test_ruleset_workflow_contract.py enforces the reachability and self-consistency of this file.
